contracts.source: MiniMax HKEX announcement: Revision of Annual Caps for Continuing Connected (08-26-2026)
contracts.signal: On August 26, 2026 MiniMax and Alibaba Cloud Computing Ltd. entered into the Supplemental Alibaba Cloud Services Agreement revising the annual caps for MiniMax's purchases of cloud products and services from USD115 million to USD300.0 million for 2026, from USD125 million to USD400.0 million for 2027 and from USD135 million to USD500.0 million for 2028 (subject to independent shareholders' approval). Historical amounts: approximately USD3.1 million (2023), USD10.0 million (2024), USD75.9 million (2025) and USD75.6 million (six months to June 30, 2026); utilization of the existing 2026 cap reached approximately 65.7% as of June 30, 2026. MiniMax cites growing demand for high-performance cloud computing for model training, surging demand for cloud products and data-center operation and maintenance for inference as API call volume grows, and cloud security; the 2025 purchases were approximately 30.0% of its R&D expenses, and the caps are set by reference to expected R&D expenses, which it expects to be mainly cloud procurement for AI infrastructure and model R&D (its plan implies additional average monthly R&D-related expenditure of approximately USD92.6 million through December 31, 2027).
contracts.value: revised annual caps USD300.0 million (2026), USD400.0 million (2027), USD500.0 million (2028); USD75.6 million purchased in H1 2026
